title: ContextAssertion

valid_from_iid.description: 15-minute telemetry slot containing valid_from (alignment key only)

recorded_at.description: when the knowledge was written down (transaction time) == the timestamp of the source artefact named by source_ref (message sent time, email sent time, document date). valid_from equals it unless the source states another start: later recording (a lock changed before anyone emailed about it) or earlier (a change announced in advance)

superseded_by.description: set iff status=superseded; its valid_from == this valid_to

corroborates.description: symmetric; same knowledge from another source

x-temporal-rules: valid_from <= valid_to (when valid_to is set); valid_to is exclusive
status=believed_true|disputed|unverified -> valid_to is null or after the snapshot (2026-11-07T00:00:00Z)
status=superseded -> superseded_by is set and successor.valid_from == valid_to
status=expired -> valid_to <= snapshot and no successor (a bounded window that ended)
the subject entity exists (entities.jsonl) at valid_from
recorded_at == timestamp of the source artefact (source_ref)
